title: hotdog tier list
blurb: crawl a handle's simcluster, find everyone who has posted about hot dogs, and rank the toppings from S to F — from their words, plus an optional photo pass: on-device CLIP finds the hot dog photos and your own vision-model key (OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini) names their toppings. @jakobsachs.blog wanted the simcluster hotdog toppings tier list.
